searchEvidence: The protected release already creates one canonical package and one catalog handoff, but it did not include the operator-visible inner manifest copy or a reviewed registry seed.
The update catalog hashes the complete ZIP, so placing the catalog inside that ZIP would create circular identity rather than a verifiable release.

The measured managed package exceeds 80 MB because it contains the required coupled self-contained Launcher; the owner approved the 128 MiB exception only for genuine 1.0.0 and validation 1.0.1 packages.
semanticOwner: The release workflow and catalog builder own one hash-bound handoff; UpdateCatalogValidator owns the mirrored version-scoped package-size admission rule
terminalContract: A protected release run preserves the exact five immutable GitHub assets and separately emits one package, catalog, byte-identical inner-manifest copy, and registry seed. Only genuine 1.0.0 and validation 1.0.1 packages may use the 128 MiB ceiling; renamed packages and every other version fail closed at 80,000,000 bytes. The 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 lab must prove install, READY switch, restart, switch-back, rollback, damage reporting, and deletion before release approval.
